transaction_key:
pub fn get_full_key(&self, key: &[u8]) -> (full_key: Vec<u8>)
        ensures full_key@ == prefix_view(self.prefix@, key@),

pub fn get_full_range(&self, range: Range<&[u8]>) -> (full_range: Range<Vec<u8>>)
